import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('/var/folders/3q/zc3tlwsj1p1_pskzk1j9r5100000gn/T/wb-evaluation-sft1jwcb/37abbc1b6aed')
spec = json.loads((root / 'evaluation-input.json').read_text())
checks = []
for name, expected in spec['input_files_sha256'].items():
    observed = hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    checks.append({'path': name, 'matches': observed == expected})
for name, expected in spec['skill_inputs_sha256'].items():
    observed = hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    checks.append({'path': name, 'matches': observed == expected})
print(json.dumps(checks, indent=2))
